initial_full_suite_environment_failure.cause: Project-local pytest scratch inherits the enclosing repository through Git ancestor discovery.
initial_full_suite_environment_failure.resolution: Kept scratch inside the owned project and bounded Git discovery at that scratch root with process-local GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES. No production or unrelated test code changed.

canonical_replay_parity.interpretation: Oracle/fixture consistency only, not model accuracy, semantic-judge agreement, human review or calibration.

compatibility_findings: Quality evaluate().code_score is an uncapped diagnostic and is unsafe as a direct reward.
The quality score still requires the genuine gpt-6-astra six-dimension judge and remains capped at 0.49 without it.
The new code-only reward applies its own strict frozen-oracle checks and critical caps; it is never reported as matched quality.
The general RFT packager drops required reference/context/hash fields and appends the older expert profile; it was inspected but not changed.
Current sealed retrieval-only prompts lack actual supplied context and cannot earn this reward without separate parent-owned context preparation.
